meanings.note: Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Alone as 違う！ or 違います, means 'No, that's wrong!'.

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Adverb traditionally used with negatives, also used colloquially with affirmatives.

examples.text: 今日は全然寒くないです。
examples.trans: It's not cold at all today.
There is no problem at all.

examples.text: 君は素養があるね、違いが分かるってことは。
examples.trans: You have real refinement, being able to tell the difference.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.

meanings.en: be decided; be settled; be certain
meanings.note: Intransitive godan verb; ～に決まっている means 'it is certain/obvious that...'.

examples.text: 明日の予定が決まりました。
彼が勝つに決まっている。

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Adverb emphasizing that there is nothing more.

examples.text: ただ本当のことを言っただけです。
ただ静かに待っていた。

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: おっさんの命が懸かってんだろうが！
examples.trans: The boss's life is hanging on the line here!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

examples.text: 来月までに保釈金の一億、死ぬ気で集めてこい！
examples.trans: Scrape together the one hundred million yen bail by next month with everything you have!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
Opposite of 表 (public surface); 裏の世界 means 'the underworld / hidden world'.

examples.text: 裏の世界を見せてやろうか。
examples.trans: Shall I show you the hidden world?
Write on the back of the paper.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

examples.text: 俺のせいです。保釈金を全額用意できなかったんで。
examples.trans: It is my fault, because I couldn't raise the full bail amount in time.

examples.text: 村西さん、新会社のビル、あそこで決めていいんですね？全額投資しますよ。
examples.trans: Mr. Muranishi, are we set on buying that building for our new company? It takes all our funds.

できる.gloss: be built; open; be able to

meanings.en: come into existence; be completed; can do
meanings.note: With buildings or stores (店ができる), means a new shop has been built or opened.

examples.text: 駅前に新しいカフェができました。
examples.trans: A new café opened in front of the station.

examples.text: 日本語が少しできます。
examples.trans: I can speak a little Japanese.

meanings.note: Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

meanings.note: Attaches to a past-stem verb form to set up a condition ('if a fire starts').

examples.text: 火事になったら大変です。
examples.trans: If a fire breaks out, it will be terrible.

examples.text: 家に帰ったら電話します。
examples.trans: I will call when I get home.

meanings.note: Prefixed to native Japanese words (お店, お二人, お持ち帰り) to add politeness.
Godan verb; past tense is 死んだ.

examples.text: 金魚が死んでしまった。

examples.trans: I don't want to die yet.

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。
文句あんのか？命の恩人に。
examples.trans: Do you have a complaint against the man who saved your life?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').

meanings.en: bring to a halt; shut off
meanings.note: Transitive verb for stopping a car, engine, or machine.

examples.text: ここに車を止めてください。
エンジンを止めました。

meanings.en: do a favor for the speaker
meanings.note: After a te-form (会ってくれる？), warmly asks 'will you do that for us?'

examples.trans: Will you come again for me?

examples.text: 母が料理を作ってくれました。
examples.trans: My mother cooked food for me.

meanings.note: 分かってる asks or states ongoing understanding; plain past 分かった means 'got it! / I understand'.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: Got it, I will come right away.

meanings.note: Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
